Cost: 500eb (Expensive) for 1

Ammo Types Available: Grenades

This Kang Tao innovation is packed with motion and thermographic sensors to locate targets hiding in dense brush or shanty town huts.

Grenade Ammunition. Can be thrown or loaded into Grenade Launchers. When used, this ammunition scans a 10m/yds x 10m/yds (5x5 squares) area centered on where it landed and sends the data to the user’s Neuroport. Anyone within this radius is marked for the next 9 seconds (3 Rounds), during which the user can see a basic outline of marked targets through Thin or Thick cover, smoke, darkness, or any other obscurement. Firing at a marked target with Smart or Improved Smart Ammunition provides a +1 bonus to the Attack Check.

Stack: 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
